input.summary: Insert a Garman insurance covenant in General Matters
input.comment: [Playbook] The Agreement has no insurance covenant even though Garman installs software, converts our data and works at our locations. We have inserted our standard minimum limits (CGL, E&O and cyber where our data is accessed) with certificates on request.

ops.text: (k) Garman shall maintain, at its own expense, throughout the term of this Agreement and for one (1) year thereafter: commercial general liability insurance of not less than USD 1,000,000 per occurrence and USD 2,000,000 in the aggregate; professional liability (errors and omissions) insurance of not less than USD 2,000,000; and, where Garman processes or has access to Sparkling's data, cyber liability insurance of not less than USD 5,000,000. Garman shall provide certificates of insurance on request.

input.summary: Insert transition assistance and data return obligations in Section 17
input.comment: [Playbook] The Agreement requires us to return Garman's materials on exit but says nothing about transition help or the return of our data. We have added a short exit provision: up to six months of transition assistance at then-current rates, data return within 30 days in machine-readable form, then certified deletion.

ops.text: (d) Upon expiry or termination of this Agreement for any reason, Garman shall (1) at Sparkling's request, provide reasonable transition assistance for up to six (6) months at Garman's then-current rates; (2) within thirty (30) calendar days, return to Sparkling all Sparkling data in Garman's possession or control in a commonly used, machine-readable format; and (3) thereafter delete such data from its systems and certify such deletion in writing.
